mechanism.summary: T056 M1 replacement for the closed stage-2 shape of interpreter-core-v2-atoms-layouts, per docs/design/property-layouts.md, in two stages on the post-T063 base: (A) layout authority for every ordinary named-property store through owned, bounded transition edges, replacing payload lookup authority in the same stage (one probe per add, the Dynamic name map and ObjectLiteralShape.lookup removed, one-pointer layout, ObjectData at most 120 bytes); (B, final) route ordinary and shared accelerated Get/Set through atoms and layouts and retire the rejecting probe chain and superseded revisions. Before every timed screen a frozen, non-timing instruction pre-gate runs exact canonical candidate and base images once per role on all 86 policy cases; a case whose candidate/base instructions exceed max(1.03, I_i) (I_i the policy's instruction hard cap) stops the screen; the pre-gate only blocks, spends no attempt, and its job, image hashes and per-case ratios are recorded in T056 whatever its result. A screen uses exactly the image whose hash passed the pre-gate; the pre-gate never replaces or cancels a timed attempt already started. Attempt accounting: max_attempts 2 counts failed screens across stages A and B together; a stage abort counts as one, an inconclusive screen spends none (existing rule); after a stage A abort the remaining attempt may reimplement stage A, and it is the last. Candidate isolation: every stage A/B candidate is this plan commit (on ae45226e, runtime equal to f58c696e) plus M1's own runtime commits; until the unit closes no runtime change on main after f58c696e is merged in (including T057 at fa96320f and string-search-linear), only tooling/docs merges; before each screen T056 records `git diff f58c696e <candidate> -- crates` showing only M1 files. Statements: (1) a diagnostic prototype exists on agent/t056-m12-diagnosis/claude (never merged); its measured numbers are instruction ratios only (steps i-viii at 1.02-1.39 against stage 1; canonical-scan bound 7-10%), no timing. (2) The stage budget 1.025, payoff 0.97 (or 1/B_i) and rank ceiling 5 are the standing values, none derived from diagnosis data. (3) The runtime is reimplemented on this base; this plan commit is an ancestor of every runtime commit and nothing is cherry-picked from the diagnosis branch. (4) Diagnostic samples (jobs *-t056-m12-*) are not profile receipts; only the exact-image receipts below are. Targets are the queue's rank 3-5 development cases with the largest layout envelope (27.3%, 32.3%, 27.9% inclusive). Higher-ranked cases are not targets: js-yaml/document (rank 1) has a 16.9% inclusive / 9.5% owner envelope and its excess is string and RegExp work owned by T057, so a target there would credit string-path effects to this unit; immutable/persistent (rank 2) has 17.5% / 15.1% and its largest excess is call/frame/env work owned by M2. Both remain ordinary controls.
mechanism.generality: Admission is ordinary named-property semantics, receiver kind and atom-domain/layout identity. Every store, constructor/literal/native/host receiver and computed key (one ToPropertyKey, then interning) uses the same authority and edges; transitions are keyed by (atom, attributes, encoding) and admitted by what a program does, never by source text, property spelling, library or benchmark identity, literal template or iteration count. No environment snapshot or per-call name map is introduced.
semantic_risks: Enumeration order, delete/re-add order, duplicate keys and more than 32/128 properties must follow the language order after edge, dictionary and Small-to-Dynamic re-encoding transitions.

Every add/delete/reconfigure/freeze/seal/prototype/lazy-property change publishes the new layout before any cached observer can reuse a slot; equal keys with different attributes take different edges.
Edge and shape retention stays bounded under key churn: evicted root edges, the 4096 live-shape budget and dictionary tombstones are tested; atom IDs never wrap or get reused.
Getters, setters, Proxy traps and native re-entry run after property and layout borrows are released; receiver identity, strict-mode write errors and exotic algorithms are preserved.
Cross-realm, eval and foreign code never interpret another atom domain's IDs; null-prototype objects use the current realm; typed keys rely on T063's canonical surrogate-pair storage.

Tier coverage stays comparable: a payoff that comes only from a tier or literal-path switch does not count; layout moves are judged on all six placements, the complete portfolio and held-out acceptance.
